name: repl bugs
summary: Interactive loop where user launches nf session and can type commands without nf prefix

rawActions.name: Establish design requirements
rawActions.summary: REPL launched when nf invoked with no args. Detects tmux via $TMUX. In tmux: 3-pane layout — top:nf watch, middle:last command echo (no prompt prefix, double-click copyable), bottom:nf> repl (input+output). No-tmux fallback: simple readline loop with nf> prompt. Exit via quit/exit/Ctrl+C. Command parsing uses cli.exec().

rawActions.name: Implement cli.exec() before REPL
rawActions.summary: Add cli.exec(args: string[]) to CLI class in src/cli/nameforma.ts. Takes pre-parsed args array (no [node,script] prefix). Creates new CLI instance per call (avoids Commander.js state issues). Returns promise. REPL calls world.logCommand(cmd) AFTER successful exec only. Errors caught and printed, REPL loop continues.

rawActions.name: Plan tmux pane management
rawActions.summary: Add history[] (max 10, type: {timestamp, user: agent|human, command}) to World class: private #history field, world.logCommand(cmd) method (appends+trims+saves), add to toJSON() and fromJson(). World obtained via World.findWorld()+World.fromPath() (see cli-task.ts:200 pattern). nf watch displays task then history below; each entry: short-ts|user|cmd. Two panes: tmux split-window -vb starts watch pane above, REPL below. Watch started via tmux send-keys. REPL stores watch pane ID, kills it on exit. --agent flag determines user type.

rawActions.name: Implement REPL loop
rawActions.summary: Create src/cli/repl.ts: readline loop with nf> prompt. Obtain world via World.findWorld()+World.fromPath(). For each input line: run child_process.exec('nf --args '+userInput) to get shell-parsed args as JSON, then call cli.exec(parsedArgs). Call world.logCommand(cmd) on success only. Errors caught, loop continues. Detect $TMUX: split pane via 'tmux split-window -vb -P -F #{pane_id}', start nf watch via tmux send-keys, store pane ID, kill on exit. On quit/exit/Ctrl+C: kill watch pane if tmux.

rawActions.name: Wire no-args launch in nameforma.ts
rawActions.summary: In src/cli/nameforma.ts: when process.argv has no command args (length <= 2), launch REPL instead of showing Commander help.

rawActions.name: Tests for REPL, cli.exec(), world.logCommand()
rawActions.summary: Unit tests: cli.exec() creates new CLI instance and routes commands correctly. world.logCommand() appends to history, trims to 10, saves world.json. REPL no-args detection. Error handling continues loop. Tmux-specific pane behavior not unit tested (requires live tmux).

rawActions.name: Add --args flag to nf CLI
rawActions.summary: Add --args global flag to CLI in src/cli/nameforma.ts. When set, print process.argv (excluding node, script, and --args) as JSON array to stdout and exit. Allows REPL to use shell for arg parsing: child_process.exec('nf --args ' + userInput) returns parsed args as JSON.

rawActions.name: REPL launches with cursor in watch pane
Bug: REPL world instance stale after CLI.exec()
rawActions.summary: REPL loads world once at startup. After CLI.exec() modifies world.json (e.g. focus changes), REPL's stale world.logCommand() overwrites those changes on save. Fix: reload world from disk before each logCommand() call.
